description: ThermalLabel Web Editor Server Component for ASP.NET CORE and Legacy ASP.NET (MVC & WebForms) applications. For the client-side component containing the Scripts/CSS files please install the Neodynamic.Web.ThermalLabelEditor.Assets package.
releaseNotes:
● New! Added support for the OS Clipboard so items can be shared between other editor instances. New `clipboard_mode` prop of type `EditorClipboardMode` (`Internal` or `System`).
● New! Added support for multiple items selection with the mouse. Added CSS props for customizing the marquee selection: `--marquee-background-color`, `--marquee-border-color`, and `--marquee-border-dash-array`.
● New! Added safe margin on canvas workspace. Customized through the CSS prop: `--workspace-safe-margin`.
● New! Added duplex label design with a 180-degree flip animation. New SVG icon for flipping the page. Added CSS props: `--duplex-flip-color` and `--duplex-flip-hover-color`.
● New! Duplex legends "Front Side" and "Back Side" color customization. Added CSS prop: `--duplex-legends-color`.
● New! Adorner legends text color and font customization. Added CSS props: `--adorner-text-color` and `--adorner-font`.
● New! Added Item Index to the tooltip info. Customized through the CSS prop: `--item-tooltip-index-color`.
● New! Added support for customizing the selector handlers' border color through the CSS prop: `--adorner-handler-border-color`.
● New! Added `show_ruler` prop to allow changing the rulers' visibility.
● New! Added `LayoutAlignment` enum to lay out selected items: `Left`, `Right`, `Bottom`, `Top`, `CenterHorizontal`, `CenterVertical`, `DistributeHorizontal`, and `DistributeVertical`.
● New! Added `setSelectedItemsToSameSize()` func to size selected items to the same dimensions.
● New! Added `beforeDuplexDesignDisabled` event to alert the user before the current label duplex design is canceled.
● New! Support for Label View Rotation. Added `view_rotation` read-only prop, the `rotateView` func and the `viewRotationChanged` event.
● New! Added a tray tied to the label canvas to hold non-visual items like `RFIDTagItem` and `LiteralItem`. Customized through the CSS props: `--tray-background-color`, `--tray-border-color`, `--tray-frame-gap`, and `--tray-icon-size`.
● New! Added `literal_image_file_name` prop to specify the icon/image that will identify a `LiteralItem` on the new label tray.
● New! Auto centering of the label canvas inside its container.
● New! Added `getLabelAsImage()` and `getLabelAsHtml()` funcs. New JS types: `Neodynamic.SDK.Printing.ImageSettings`, `Neodynamic.SDK.Printing.ImageFormat`.
● New! Added `dispose()` and `destroy()` funcs.
● New! Added `selectAll()`, `selectItemByIndex(i)`, `selectItemsByIndexes(itemIndexes)`, `selectItemByName(name)`, `selectItemsByNames(names)`, `selectItemsByTag(tag)` and `selectItemsByType(type)` funcs.
● New! Added support for Rectangle and Ellipse label shapes.
